text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
NameOf(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
SetOfIslands(x) ::: x is a set of islands.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is part of Antarctica.
SouthWestCoast(x, y) ::: x is on the southwest coast of y.
Question:  
There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
Premises:
∃x (Cove(x) ∧ NameOf(x, y) ∧ Place(y) ∧ LocatedIn(x, z) ∧ NameOf(y, "Bulgaria") ∧ LocatedIn(z, Antarctica)) ::: There exists a cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
